headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when The Young Bucks vs. Fenix & PAC clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.65 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. It was the first title opportunity of Fenix & PAC's career. A brutal, controversial title defense that later became part of a match fans voted the feud of the entire year ? the Bucks controversially tore off Rey Fenix's mask mid-match before superkicking him for the pin, a heel turn moment that truly shocked the crowd.

On a Friday in 2023, back when the inaugural IWGP Tag Team Titles was crowned as Aussie Open vs. Best Friends went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.72. Aussie Open successfully defended their IWGP Tag Team Titles against Best Friends in their first defense since winning the belts at NJPW's Sakura Genesis just days earlier.
On this day in 2023, Taya Valkyrie competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Emi Sakura, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.71.

secondaries.text: It was 2021 when the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Darby Allin vs. Matt Hardy went to war in a Falls Count Anywhere match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.01 ? a strong outing. For Matt Hardy, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
On a Friday in 2023, back when Jack Perry vs. Shawn Spears crossed paths for the first time ever, serving as the night's main event on Rampage, rated 5.96.
Looking back to 2021, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Chris Jericho and Dax Harwood on Dynamite, rated 6.59.
